test: Occitan <-> Indonesian matched-meaning Mirror-Man and backwards-word compatibility

design.lexicon: One full Kaikki/Wiktextract streaming pass extracts only Occitan and Indonesian entries with usable IPA and English glosses.
design.matching: Only exact normalized English gloss/concept matches are compared, preventing arbitrary look-alike word fishing.
design.phonetic_tests: Direct gate-path similarity, literal path reversal, and all eight preregistered identity/reverse/place/manner Mirror-Man transforms.
design.orthographic_tests: Direct spelling similarity, reversed-Occitan spelling similarity, and exact backwards spelling matches.
design.null: For every matched meaning, ten deterministic mismatched Indonesian meanings provide a chance/phonotactic control.
design.falsification: Literal backwards compatibility requires reversal to beat direct alignment and wrong-meaning reversal overall, and to improve a majority of matched concepts.

boundary: A positive result would establish a reproducible structural correspondence in this representation, not by itself genealogical descent or geographic origin.
